q1_issues.issue: the event noun 'acceptance' is classed as the verb 'accept' (symbol sk_accept_1), but that is derivation rather than inflection, which the lemmatization rule bars and which the instruction set's own nominalization examples avoid (sk_refinement_1, (Member sk_ceremony_1 ceremony))

q2_gaps: an OBJECTIVE 's-genitive on a nominalization ('Coraline Ash's acceptance' read as she is the one accepted): the instruction set states only the SUBJECT genitive case (Marta's objection -> Agent/Experiencer) and the object of-phrase case (-> the Of oblique), so an object role on an 's-genitive event noun has no stated encoding
notes: Correctly leaves the acceptance tenseless so nothing asserts it occurred, and correctly keeps 'Old' inside the capitalized run rather than stripping it as a courtesy title.
